note: Attacker-controlled offset 'data' of the IIQ entry with tag 0x110 materializes the correction-metadata ByteStream that later carries the spline control points.

The correction-metadata entry with tag 0x431 dispatches to CorrectQuadrantMultipliersCombined, which parses the shared x-coordinates and quadrant y-multipliers from the file into 9-point control-point vectors.
A Spline<ushort16> is constructed from the 9 control points (0,0) + 7 file-supplied points + (65535,65535), yielding num_coords=9 and num_segments=8.
segments is resized to num_coords=9 logical elements; prepare() will later shrink the logical size to num_segments=8 via pop_back().

pop_back() drops the temporary last segment, so segments.size() becomes 8 == num_segments; the reverse loop below still indexes segments[i+1] up to segments[num_segments] (== segments[8]), one past the logical end.

On the first iteration i == num_segments-1 == 7, sn aliases segments[i+1] == segments[8], and reading sn.c is an 8-byte container-overflow READ past the vector's logical end (AddressSanitizer crash site).
